## Notes

- Printed only in the rules text of 48.0 (no chart sheet); the adoc transcription is the second reading of the scan
- attaches_to names the Land Game (5.2) point the step corresponds to, using common.schema phase names plus initiative-determination, naval-convoy and turn-end; null = no Land Game counterpart
- Stage V is the first operations stage; stages VI and VII repeat it in full
- In stage V, phases A-F are joint (phase F once per stage by both sides, ruling R-031) and G-L are done by Player A then Player B
- Tactical shipping sits in Land Game stage II; here it is a segment of the organisation phase, every stage
- logistics_game_only marks the steps that exist only with the Logistics Game (stores expenditure, water distribution, attrition). Without them, and keeping the air_game_only steps, the rows are the Land-and-Air sequence of 33.0 in the same order
